name: ai-assisted-work
description: AI-Assisted Work as a bundle of two standalone Agent Skills: work (work items, activities, tasks and initiatives in plain files) and thread (a tree of intents and a bulletin board for agents). Each installs on its own with bin/skills.mjs.

check.description: git is on the PATH, and the thread store is a git clone or has a remote to clone
.aaw-config.yaml, when present, names work item and initiative paths that resolve, and any deliverables_register exists
